title: refactor(ci): upgrade Node to 18, consolidate workflows, and improve build cache
author: Priya Natarajan
release_notes: Upgrade CI to Node 18, consolidate duplicate workflows into reusable workflows, and improve build/test caching to reduce CI runtime and flakiness.
body:
Summary: Upgrade project CI from Node 16 -> Node 18, consolidate and DRY .github workflows, standardize setup-node usage, and improve cache keys for build/test to reduce runtime and flakiness. Motivation: Node 16 is EOL and multiple workflow copies across repositories had subtle drift (different cache keys, inconsistent action pinning, duplicated lint/test matrix definitions). This PR centralizes common behavior into reusable workflows, bumps the default Node version to 18, updates a few devDependencies (eslint, jest) required for Node 18, and fixes a couple of flaky tests that surfaced under the newer runtime.

Checklist: 
- [x] Upgrade GitHub Actions runners to use node-setup@v3 and Node 18 runtime
- [x] Consolidate duplicated workflows into .github/workflows/reusable/* where appropriate
- [x] Improve cache keys to include pnpm-lock.yaml / package-lock.json + hash of relevant files
- [x] Pin critical actions to stable-major versions (e.g., actions/checkout@v4, actions/cache@v4)
- [x] Run full CI across monorepo and fix failing jobs
- [x] Add migration notes to developer docs (docs/ci.md)

What changed (high-level):
- Introduced .github/workflows/reusable/node-build.yml and node-test.yml to capture common matrix and caching logic.
- Rewrote service and SDK workflows to call the reusable workflows via workflow_call.
- Updated .nvmrc and package.json engines to "18.x" where present.
- Upgraded devDependencies that were incompatible with Node 18: eslint -> 9.x, jest -> 29.x, ts-jest -> 29.x (small test adapter fixes included).
- Improved cache key strategy for build/test: includes OS, Node version, package-lock/pnpm-lock hash, and a repo files hash to avoid accidental stale caches.
- Fixed two flaky tests in redwood-sdk-python-integration-mock (test timeout tweaked) and redwood/redwood-server (fixed a race in request teardown).
- Minor Dockerfile tweak: set NODE_VERSION=18 in multi-stage build.

Commits (summary):
- feat(ci): add reusable node-build workflow and cache strategy
- chore(ci): upgrade setup-node usage to v3 and default to Node 18
- fix(tests): address race in server teardown (increase wait and remove global timer)
- feat(docs): add CI migration guide and troubleshooting notes
- chore(deps): bump eslint/jest/ts-jest for Node 18 compatibility
- ci: pin actions/checkout@v4 and actions/cache@v4

Files / areas touched (high level):
- .github/workflows/reusable/node-build.yml (new)
- .github/workflows/reusable/node-test.yml (new)
- .github/workflows/ci.yml (updated): now calls reusable workflows for build/test/lint
- package.json (selected packages updated) across multiple packages in monorepo
- package-lock.json / pnpm-lock.yaml updates in affected packages
- .nvmrc (updated to 18)
